statement: Rule-id provenance: 7 rules absent at both v3.0.0.0 (2026-03-27) and v3.6.0.0 (2026-06-18) tags (GREP_CONVENTION, GENERATED_METADATA_INTEGRITY, GENERATED_METADATA_DRIFT, SCAFFOLD_NEVER_TOUCHED, METADATA_DISK_PATH_CONSISTENCY, STATUS_CROSS_DOC_CONSISTENCY, GRAPH_METADATA_CHILD_IDENTITY); 3 only at v3.6 (FRONTMATTER_MEMORY_BLOCK, SPEC_DOC_SUFFICIENCY, CANONICAL_SAVE_LINEAGE_REQUIRED); 10 at v3.0 (AI_PROTOCOLS unstable across tags). Enforcement-at-tag inferred.
source: git grep per rule id at tag trees; git log -S GREP_CONVENTION

statement: Classification: v4-era rule findings are artifacts of new contracts over old docs (missing sidecars, fingerprint rollout expectations); 'no anchors found' is a template-era artifact for v3.0 docs (v3.0 speckit assets emit no ANCHOR markers, v3.6 YAMLs do) while duplicate/unclosed anchors, cross-doc bucket mismatches, broken links and stale paths are real defects no v3 rule checked.

Entry-status axis resolved: check-grep-convention.sh helper emits per-detail severity labels plus a separate status line that sets RULE_STATUS (fail fallback); orchestrator counts a warning only on warn entry status. The 10 F-013 rows are error entries with warn-labeled details; no warnings policy clears them.

Correction to F-009: STATUS_CROSS_DOC_CONSISTENCY compares spec.md vs implementation-summary.md Status buckets and fails only on bucket mismatch; token canonicalization cannot clear it. Clearing routes: evidence-derived bucket alignment (meaning-bearing metadata rewrite) or grandfathering. Blanking one Status to reach not-applicable is rejected (masks future findings).

Least validator change exists as a pattern: check-ac-closure.sh grandfathers packets created before a rollout cutoff to advisory on every branch, keyed on creation date; per-rule ENFORCE switches also exist (STATUS_CROSS_DOC, METADATA_DISK_CONSISTENCY, CHILD_DRIFT, AC_COVERAGE). Extending the cutoff pattern to the F-011 policy surface keeps every post-cutoff finding an error. Global ENFORCE=false demotion rejected.

TEMPLATE_SOURCE is a first-70-lines marker check for 'SPECKIT_TEMPLATE_SOURCE:'; details are bare filenames. Deterministic transform: insert a provenance comment (emitted form at spec.md:13) with an honest legacy value; cost is one comment line, no content bytes changed.
source: runtime/lib/validation/orchestrator.ts (TEMPLATE_SOURCE region); spec.md:13; git grep at v3.0.0.0

statement: Rule implementations split across two layers: 11 classes in TypeScript (orchestrator.ts, spec-doc-structure.ts, generated-metadata-integrity.ts) and 9 in shell checkers under runtime/cli/rules/ where the enforcement switches and grandfather pattern live.

reason: F-018: the rule compares cross-doc buckets, not per-line tokens
